access_barrier: Phase02 may curate/assign sealed final roles and audit labels as curator, but must not train/evaluate/tune a final-test model or expose final-test labels to development code.
blocks_audit: Unreadable/missing control bundle or invalid hashes/schema/version
No raw ZIPs or extracted source folders identified and hashed
Missing exact statistical/source contract or unresolved software failure affecting audit inputs
blocks_phase02_exit: Actual independent calibration counts or S2 population/unit/count approval unresolved
independent_unit_rule: Group by highest dependence level (site/session/parent/original). Choose one label-blind representative per defensible certification unit; audit whether units are actually IID within class.
pending_allowed_for_audit: Unfinished model GPU smoke or model permission decision
S3/S4/S5/S7 later-stage approvals; no claim they are waived
required_inputs: same raw dataset version with matching ZIP SHA256 or extracted-directory SHA256 tree hashes
sequence: Discover mounted control ZIP and sidecar; reject ambiguity rather than guess latest
Verify ZIP fingerprint before safe extraction; validate paths, sizes and internal hashes
Verify phase01_manifest schema/version and critical artifact hashes
Resolve raw mounts by ZIP SHA256 or extracted-directory member/tree SHA256; no silent source substitution
Read warnings, exclusions, source/permission ledgers and unresolved decisions
Inventory pairs, decode validation, exact/decoded/perceptual hashes and source aggregation overlap
Recover site/session/parent lineage; quarantine ambiguity; adjudicate masks and confirmed negatives
Count independent units, choose population and fixed count plan with S2 review
Create grouped partitions and label-blind representatives; freeze split/access manifests; no final calibration
Export Phase02 artifacts, gates and next handoff
